mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_source(source_id, account_id, type, origin_id, title, status, current_version) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{originId}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE', 0) ON CONFLICT (account_id, type, origin_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ma_source WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND type = #{type} AND origin_id = #{originId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ma_source WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM ma_source WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND type = #{type} AND origin_id = #{originId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM ma_source WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND type = #{type} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, source_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT account_id, type, before_time, before_id FROM ma_source_cursor WHERE cursor_id = #{cursorId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_source_cursor(cursor_id, account_id, type, before_time, before_id) VALUES (#{cursorId}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{beforeTime}, #{beforeId})
mapper.select: SELECT payload_fingerprint, source_id, version FROM ma_source_operation WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND operation_id = #{operationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_source_operation(account_id, operation_id, payload_fingerprint, source_id, version) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{operationId}, #{fingerprint}, #{sourceId}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT v.* FROM ma_source_version v JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = v.source_id WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.source_id = #{sourceId} AND v.version = #{version} AND v.status != 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT a.* FROM ma_anchor a JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = a.source_id WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.source_id = #{sourceId} AND a.version = #{version} ORDER BY a.kind, a.ordinal
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_source_version(source_id, version, content_sha256, status, answer_state, file_ref, body_markdown) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{version}, #{digest}, 'INDEX_PENDING', #{answerState}, #{fileRef}, #{bodyMarkdown})

INSERT INTO ma_anchor(anchor_id, source_id, version, kind, ordinal, content_sha256, locator_json, text) VALUES (#{anchor.anchorId}, #{anchor.sourceId}, #{anchor.version}, #{anchor.kind}, #{anchor.ordinal}, #{anchor.contentSha256}, #{anchor.locatorJson}, #{anchor.text})
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_source SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE ma_source SET status = 'DELETED', origin_id = #{retiredOrigin} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_outbox(event_id, account_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, kind, payload_digest, status, index_revision) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{accountId}, 'SOURCE', #{sourceId}, #{version}, #{kind}, #{digest}, 'PENDING', #{indexRevision})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ma_source_version WHERE file_ref = #{fileRef}
